answer: Running a farm hence means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. Because the age is read from the pulse checkpoint rather than self-declared, the dawn audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. An identity must be at least 2 epochs old on the vine ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
